compiled_state.title: S5.T4: Record design decision (bump-BEFORE-final-review) + sequencing constraint on S5 ticket
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: Design decision recorded \xe2\x80\x94 chose bump-BEFORE-final-review (post-bump HEAD reviewed; review against final state). The chosen path is implemented and documented.
- DD3: Sequencing relative to S4's RED-test-blocker \xe2\x80\x94 documented in the ticket and in the S_docs ADR.

## Implementation Notes

Add a structured DESIGN_DECISION comment to the S5 ticket via:
```bash
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 0c55-1103-a14d-431e "DESIGN_DECISION: bump-BEFORE-final-review

**Chosen path**: Insert pre-merge phase _phase_source_branch_version_bump that commits the version-bump on the source branch (session/...) HEAD BEFORE PR creation/update. Review fires against the post-bump HEAD (review-against-final-state).

**Rejected alternative**: bump-AFTER-final-review with branch-protection re-review-dismissal accepted. Rejected because re-review-dismissal undermines SC5(a)'s manual-review signal integrity \xe2\x80\x94 the epic is tightening review discipline, not weakening it.

**Rejected alternative**: two-PR pattern (separate version-bump PR). Rejected as premature abstraction (new branch prefix for one-line bump), conflicts with S1's single DSO-Story-Merge: trailer model, doubles CI cycles.

**Sequencing relative to S4's RED-test-blocker**: the version-bump touches ONLY the configured version file (e.g., VERSION or pyproject.toml). This file is never in .test-index (which maps source files to test files, not version-tracking files). Therefore S5's bump cannot reintroduce a RED marker AFTER S4's check passed, regardless of execution order. The check runs the same way on the post-bump HEAD as on the pre-bump HEAD.

**ADR cross-reference**: S_docs (cdc0-8cfc-38e6-4e7d) will record this as an ADR with full rationale linked here."
```

This task is a GREEN task that produces a ticket comment as its output \xe2\x80\x94 no code change.

## File Impact

No source file changes. Output is a structured ticket comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Design-decision comment exists on the S5 ticket
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 0c55-1103-a14d-431e 2>&1 | grep -q "DESIGN_DECISION: bump-BEFORE-final-review"
- [ ] Comment documents the rejected alternatives and rationale
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 0c55-1103-a14d-431e 2>&1 | grep -E "Rejected alternative|re-review-dismissal|two-PR"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user

comments.body: CHECKPOINT:batch-complete — DESIGN_DECISION ticket comment posted to S5 story (0c55-1103-a14d-431e). Chosen path: bump-BEFORE-final-review. Rejected alternatives + rationale recorded. No source changes.
